It specifies that in the GLSL AST, 'leaves are primitive shapes, with each leaf is annotated with a list of transformations to apply to the input to that function' (domain modifications attached to leaves). It further explains that 'intermediate tree... is not the same as the conceptual tree... because some operations apply to the domain... and some to the range.' Specifically, it notes that range operations (like union) form the internal structure (function calls acting on the range), while domain modifications (transformations) are handled at the leaves. This matches the claim exactly.
